meta.title: Privacy policy
meta.description: How Mobiera SAS handles personal data on mobiera.io: the contact form, analytics with consent, retention, your rights, and how to reach our data-protection contact.

title: Privacy policy
lead: Last updated: at launch. This policy is pending legal review.

who.title: Who is responsible
who.body: {name}, NIT {nit}, {address}, is the data controller for mobiera.io. Data-protection contact: <mail>{email}</mail>.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.form: Contact form. Name, email, organization, topic and message, and a CV if you apply for a role. We use them to answer you and, for applications, to assess your profile. Submissions are stored for 24 months, applications for 12 months unless you ask us to delete them sooner.
collect.analytics: Analytics. With your consent, anonymized usage statistics (pages visited, device type, approximate region) to improve the site. No analytics cookie is set before you accept. See the cookie policy.
collect.logs: Server logs. IP address, user agent and requested URL, kept for 30 days for security and troubleshooting.
collect.noSale: We do not sell personal data and do not use it for advertising.

basis.title: Legal basis
basis.body: Your consent for analytics; our legitimate interest in answering your message and keeping the site secure; the steps needed before a contract when you ask about our products.

processors.title: Processors
processors.body: The site runs on infrastructure operated by Mobiera. Form submissions are delivered by email to Mobiera mailboxes; analytics, if you consent, go to our analytics provider.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability and objection, under Colombian Law 1581 of 2012 and, where it applies, the GDPR. Write to <mail>{email}</mail>. We answer within 15 business days.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We publish changes here with the date of the update.
